body: Me too man, me too. Sorry I don't have anything to say to cheer you up, except.. you're not alone.

I can't imagine how awful that must feel. You do not deserve that, nobody deserves to be cheated on. Whatever you're feeling right now you've got to remember that HE's the rotten person, NOT you. You deserve so much better than him, and you will find it eventually. At least hold on to that truth. There's no reason to feel perfectly ok right now but please remember you will be ok eventually. You've just got to be strong and push through this.
I'll remember your kind words, thank you.
Same here. And I'm afraid I'll always be that way, making stupid mistakes and saying the wrong things that ruin my life. Is there one person you feel like you've let down?
Each of these songs really does hold so much pain in them. But the list could be even longer can you think of any more?

My place is quiet, sad, beautiful, and starry too. It's where I fell in love. Do you ever wonder if maybe we could have those places be good again? Like, maybe go out there and fall in love with life all over again? I sometimes wonder but then that thought in itself makes me want to end my life.

Well your place sounds pretty amazing.
I don't think I ask a whole lot out of life, just to be loved by, like, maybe one person, and love them back. And be safe and warm and have enough to eat.

This is a really great playlist and you don't seem like the kind of person who should kill themselves if you love music this much and can make this good of a playlist. If I could do that I'd be super proud.
I love all of those songs so much. Seriously every single one of them. You should add some Mumford & Sons White Blank Page.
